_about: Every action a companion can take, in one place. 'runs_in': 'game' actions are carried out by a runner of the same name in Claude_BP/scripts/main.js (RUNNERS), 'brain' actions by brain.py, 'script' ones by the command handler in main.js itself. 'offer': 'all' = listed for every companion, 'role' = only for roles that list it in their extra_actions, 'companion' = only for companions with the setting named in 'when' (e.g. a band), 'internal' = started by the game itself, never offered. 'secs' is how long a game action may run before it gives up. 'use' is the call Claude sees and 'doc' what it does. After editing, run: python3 tools/gen_actions.py

goto.doc: walk to a player or a spot

shoot.doc: shoot with a bow from a distance (needs a bow and arrows)

mine.doc: find and mine blocks (stone and ores need a pickaxe; iron needs a stone pickaxe; obsidian needs a diamond pickaxe)

craft.doc: craft an item (tools, furnace, chest, bread, bed, ladder, doors and the like need a crafting table with you or nearby)

place.doc: put one block down next to you

build.doc: place blocks yourself, one at a time; or "blocks":[[x,y,z],...] instead of a shape. Small jobs only

dig.doc: break blocks (fix mistakes); never someone else's build

fill.doc: scoop a lava or water pool into an empty bucket (add "x","y","z" to go to a known pool first)

store.doc: put things in a chest nearby (places your chest if needed)

take.doc: take things out of a chest nearby

cook.doc: cook raw food or smelt ore; stand by a furnace with fuel

give.doc: walk over and hand something to someone

eat.doc: eat the best food you carry

portal.doc: build a Nether portal frame 2 blocks ahead and light it: 10 obsidian (or a lava bucket per block + a water bucket: the bucket portal) + flint and steel

enter_portal.doc: walk into a lit portal nearby and go through (to the Nether and back)

idle.doc: stop what you're doing and stay with your buddy

plan.doc: for anything bigger than a few blocks: design it first (a design step works out the whole build); "where" is its north-west floor corner (open, flat ground near your buddy; the floor sits at that y). Then build it with next_step

design.doc: design a build for your builders to make ("where" = its north-west floor corner); design again if they want changes

next_step.doc: build the next part of your plan (it shows in "Your project")

cancel_plan.doc: drop the plan (e.g. your buddy wants something else)

taxi.doc: drive the taxi to a place or to someone; the taxi appears by you if it's not around and you get in yourself (riders tap it to sit in the back)

park.doc: stop the taxi and let everyone out

snatch.doc: toddle up and grab something they carry (often what's in their hand), then run off with it; if they catch you, it drops back at their feet

distract.doc: crawl into their way so they forget what they were doing

sing.doc: put on a show with your band (your bandmates join in by themselves)

perform.doc: a band member joining a show on stage (started by sing)

chase.doc: running after whoever snatched something (started by snatch)

stand.doc: standing in a numbered spot of a line-up (started by the brain when a player asks a crew to line up)
